Text:
After a few listens it has grown on me a bit but it’s far from being a favorite. It’s an interesting direction to take her music on, but I don’t think it suits her, at times I felt like it borrowed too much from Imogen Heap and kind of barged into Pinkpanthress territory and it always turns me off from a project when I hear an artist sounding like another artist. I wasn’t thrown off by the subject of the album or anything like that, it just didn’t hold my attention.
The production goes hard but I find the overuse of staccato a bit jarring from someone who is arguably one of the best vocalist of the last decade and a lot of the vocal choices don’t compliment the songs for me. I typically feel like her albums are more dynamic and you go through a bit of an emotional rollercoaster through it but this album is much more still. I also have to say that not having any other songwriters on the album kinda burdens the project in my opinion, there’s this subtle genius in how ambiguous the album is but I feel like if a few more voices entered the chat, the lyricism would be much tighter and profound. With that being said, I could play this on the background while I clean and let it play till the end, it’s just not one of those albums that touch my heart.
